summary.text: Bonnie Jackson is the Republican candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 42 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Felipe Sousa Lazaballet.
Jackson is an attorney who has practiced for 30 years and who ran for the same seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Bonnie Jackson was born in California and graduated from James Madison Memorial High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 1991 and a law degree from the South Texas College of Law in 1995.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has been a practicing attorney for 30 years, raised three children in Orange County with her husband, and served as a volunteer guardian ad litem for abused and neglected children.
Jackson ran for Florida House District 42 in 2022 and lost the general election to incumbent Anna Eskamani, 43.4% to 56.6%.
In her 2026 survey responses, she listed safe neighborhoods and streets, good jobs and business investment as her key messages, and said public safety is the main job of government.
